examples.english: They shall bring the shoulder of the choice-offering, and the breast of the separation upon the burnt-offerings of the fat, to separate for a separation before the Lord; and it shall be a perpetual ordinance for thee and thy sons and thy daughters with thee, as the Lord commanded Moses.

examples.coptic: ⲛⲉⲙϯⲙⲉⲥⲧⲉⲛϩⲏⲧ ⲛⲧⲉⲡⲓⲫⲱⲣϫ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ⲛⲉⲙⲡⲓϣⲱⲃϣ **ⲛⲧⲉⲡⲓⲟⲩⲱϯ **ⲉⲃⲟⲗ**** ⲉⲣⲉⲧⲉⲛⲉⲟⲩⲟⲙⲟⲩ ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩⲙⲁ ⲉϥⲟⲩⲁⲃ ⲛⲑⲟⲕ ⲛⲉⲙⲛⲉⲕϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲡⲉⲕⲏⲓ ⲛⲉⲙⲁⲕ ⲉⲧⲁⲩⲧⲏⲓϥ ⲅⲁⲣ ⲛⲁⲕ ⲛⲟⲩⲛⲟⲙⲓⲙⲟⲛ ⲛⲉⲙⲟⲩⲛⲟⲙⲓⲙⲟⲛ ⲛⲛⲉⲕϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛⲛⲓϣⲟⲩϣⲱⲟⲩϣⲓ ⲛⲛⲟϩⲉⲙ ⲛⲧⲉⲛⲉⲛϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲙⲡⲓⲥⲣⲁⲏⲗ
examples.english: And ye shall eat the breast of separation, and the shoulder of the choice-offering in the holy place, thou and thy sons and thy house with thee; for it has been given as an ordinance for thee and an ordinance for thy sons, of the sacrifices of peace-offering of the children of Israel.
